gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically proven diagnosis of central nervous system (CNS) malignant tumor: IDH-mutant high-grade glioma, other high-grade glioma, or other high-grade CNS tumors.
Glioma; CNS Tumor, Adult; CNS Tumor, Childhood

candidate_evidence.quote: This clinical trial is a 2-phase trial designed to evaluate the safety of tarlatamab in combination with a fixed dose of metronomic temozolomide in adolescents and adults with CNS tumors

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Confirmed progressive or refractory disease after at least one line of standard therapy containing radiotherapy and for which no further effective standard therapy exists.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To identify biomarkers predictive of tumor response including DLL3 expression during treatment using descriptive statistics and appropriate multivariate models

role_evidence.quote: then tarlatamab at 10mg every D1 \& D15 of each 4-week cycle thereafter in combination with temozolomide from C2D1.

agents.drug_class_hint: DLL3 x CD3 bispecific T-cell engager antibody (approved for small-cell lung cancer)

role_evidence.quote: It will be administered from the first day of the second cycle, at a dose of 50 mg/m²/day, continuously.

source_quote.quote: Tumors expressing DLL3 based on IHC staining performed on archival tumor sample i.e. at least 1+ on IHC
Exploratory analyses in tumor will be performed in an effort to understand the association of DLL3 expression with treatment response.

coder_notes: Glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels; 'other high-grade glioma' likely includes glioblastoma but per C7 the trial is high_grade_glioma_unspecified (excluded at S5). Mixed age (>=12 years). Metronomic temozolomide is given at the same fixed dose in all cohorts and coded soc_backbone; tarlatamab is the investigational agent. DLL3 expression during treatment is an exploratory predictive analysis, coded target_engagement no (not framed as target modulation); adjudicator may consider unclear. The interventions quote contains a literal backslash before the ampersand as in the record.
